MOLECULAR GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Service

PATIENT DETAILS
Name: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
Hospital No: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Amniotic fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Reason for referral: Prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities
Gestational age: [redacted] weeks

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence-Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR) for rapid aneuploidy detection

METHODOLOGY
QF-PCR analysis was performed on uncultured amniocytes using fluorescently labeled primers for short tandem repeat (STR) markers on chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. A minimum of four informative markers were analyzed per chromosome. DNA was extracted from 1ml of amniotic fluid and amplified using multiplex PCR. Fragment analysis was performed on an ABI 3500 Genetic Analyzer.

RESULTS

Chromosome 13:
Markers analyzed: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
Result: Normal diallelic pattern observed
Interpretation: Consistent with two copies of chromosome 13

Chromosome 18:
Markers analyzed: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
Result: Normal diallelic pattern observed
Interpretation: Consistent with two copies of chromosome 18

Chromosome 21:
Markers analyzed: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446
Result: Normal diallelic pattern observed
Interpretation: Consistent with two copies of chromosome 21

Sex chromosome markers:
AMELOGENIN: XY pattern detected
Result: Consistent with male fetus

CONCLUSION
PCR analysis consistent with normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21. No abnormality detected.

This QF-PCR result indicates a low risk for trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), and trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) in this pregnancy.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Complete karyotype analysis of G-banded chromosomes from cultured amniocytes to follow. While QF-PCR is highly accurate for detecting common aneuploidies, it does not detect all chromosomal abnormalities. Full karyotype analysis will provide comprehensive cytogenetic evaluation.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
